title: butyrospermum poissonii
intro: Butyrospermum poissonii, commonly known as African butter tree, is a plant species that belongs to the Sapotaceae family. It is valued for its rich source of nut butter, which is rich in fatty acids and has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits. The health benefits of Butyrospermum poissonii nut butter include its potential to act as an antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory agent, supporting skin health and wound healing. The nut butter is rich in bioactive constituents such as palmitic acid, stearic acid, and oleic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
